zh: 为什么蜡烛图形态没有用
note: ZH intro already asserts patterns are useless; EN only announces the topic. The stronger claim is made later (cue 175: patterns alone are useless).

en: or they'll work 90% of the time
note: The 90% claim attributed to ads is missing in ZH.
ZH adds a remark not spoken.

en: bearish engulfing top on the daily chart
zh: (注: Al Brooks也讲吞噬线，但不是形态，需要结合背景)
note: Parenthetical note is the translator's, not the lecturer's; must not be quoted as course content.

en: then it closed on its low
note: EN describes the close (on its low); ZH says it traded below the prior bar's low. Check chart frames around 240-253 s.
EN points to a chart level for the risk; ZH paraphrases as 'stop is small'.

zh: 每当你在强上涨趋势中 看到一个“顶部”
note: ZH adds 'in a strong bull trend'; plausible from the chart but not spoken.
Rendered 震荡区间 throughout (cues 109,146,148,155,178,302,367,369,389). Many Brooks Chinese materials use 交易区间; canonical choice must follow the abu-1a..2c glossary.

zh: 大趋势反转 / 大反转
note: Inconsistent: 大趋势反转 (cue 115) vs 大反转 (cues 144, 239, 306, 382). Pick one canonical term.
EN refers to sell signals that failed while the market kept rising; ZH says 'falling, falling'.

en: a lot of them are dishonest
zh: 他们中的大部分都不诚实
note: 'a lot' rendered as 'most'.
ZH adds 'bigger'. Check chart frames around 685-695 s.
Duplicated 是.
地点 should be 低点.
Elsewhere momentum is 动能 (cues 244, 267, 268, 272, 292, 296, 304). Use one term.

en: sell even the close of this bar
zh: 在大阴线的收盘去追空
note: ZH adds 'big bear bar'; check the chart.

zh: 交易者在每个前期低点挂单买入
note: ZH adds limit orders (挂单) and 'prior'.
'early' is lost; better 早期的强势迹象.

en: We have a big reversal bar.
zh: 但是突破失败，大的反转K线向下
note: ZH adds 'breakout failed' and 'downward'. Check chart frames around 1270-1282 s.

en: probably going to continue back down
note: ZH adds a target (bottom of range).
Probability of this breakout rendered as general frequency.

zh: 震荡区间向下突破失败
note: ZH adds 'failed'. Check chart.
ZH introduces 'Breakout Mode' (a distinct Brooks term); the EN subtitle only says 'breakout'. Audio not checked.

zh: 我会在突破的时候做空
note: ZH adds 'at the breakout'.

en: A minor reversal, possible Final Flag
zh: 前期的反弹，有可能是末端旗形
note: 'minor reversal' rendered as 'the earlier rally'.

zh: 不错的反转信号K线（也是双K反转）
note: '(also a two-bar reversal)' is the translator's addition; verify on chart.

en: bet that will continue down at least for a little bit more
zh: 我会在做空信号K下方开仓做空
note: ZH cue 380 has content not in EN 380 (entry below the signal bar); ZH 381 carries EN 380's meaning.

en: I get stressed out constantly looking for reversals
zh: 因为指标在不断寻找趋势中的反转
note: EN: the trader using indicators keeps hunting reversals/breakouts and gets stressed. ZH: the indicators are hunting reversals.
EN subtitle says 'diversion'; context and ZH indicate 'divergence'.

zh: 几乎没有反弹的下降趋势
note: Named Brooks pattern rendered descriptively; canonical form such as 小回调下降趋势 should follow the glossary.

en: it can work and you can make a fortune
note: Point is that the payoff can be huge but rare; ZH loses 'fortune'.

en: Every now and then you'll make a lot of money
zh: （前提是能够坚定持有，而不是赚了一点就离场）
note: Parenthetical advice is the translator's, not the lecturer's.
Translator's aside.

en: bleed to death from a thousand papercuts
note: 水滴石穿 means persistence wears through stone (a positive idiom); EN means many small losses are fatal. Suggest 积少成多的小亏损会让你失血而亡 / 千刀万剐式的小亏损.
Standard term is 分形; 分型 has a different specific meaning in Chinese technical analysis.

en: risk on your trade is no bigger than the risk on any other trade
zh: 用非常小的仓位来控制你的风险
note: Key point (keep per-trade risk the same as on other trades) is lost.
Hedged EN rendered absolute.

en: probably don't help you make any money
note: 'probably' dropped.
